description:
**Original Novel:**  
[Naver Novel](https://novel.naver.com/webnovel/list.nhn?novelId=1119357), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=9496707)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=827511), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11293959)
Kim Soo-young, who was a job seeker, had a landlord who was sensitive to sound. In order to protect her perfect honey part-time job, she takes on the job of housekeeper in place of her injured aunt. However, trouble continues to arise between Soo-young, who says whatever she wants to say, and the sensitive landlord. But... an unexpected romance blooms between them, and they learn each other's secrets...
